name: Convert QBO SalesReceipt Into Karbon SalesReceipt
purpose: Converts a QBO SalesReceipt JSON (sent by LedgerLink) into the Karbon SalesReceipt JSON: reads address, email, totals, tax and date fields, takes the shipping line (item SHIPPING_ITEM_ID) out as shipAmt, keeps only item lines, looks up the Karbon ids for the transaction, customer and deposit account (Lookup FMId), converts each line with Convert QBO SalesLine, and returns the Karbon JSON.
open_question: Shipping is carried as a line with the literal item id SHIPPING_ITEM_ID (steps 76-80). Payment method, class and discount are not converted. Customers are resolved by a handler because ZeitGeist overrides them (step 96).

name: Handle Sales Receipt Push to QBO
purpose: Pushes a Karbon sales receipt to QuickBooks Online. Sends the customer to QBO first if it has no QBO id (and records an external link), converts the receipt with Convert Karbon SalesReceipt, sends it to QBO through LedgerLink, then stores the QBO id and document number on the receipt, clears the send flag, and stores the QBO line ids and numbers on the lines. A failed send changes status Edit to 'Need to Send'.
